usage: Common noun for a person who serves customers in a restaurant, cafe, bar, or similar place.
Very natural in service settings; it is more general than some job-specific labels like waiter or waitress.
Can refer to staff of any gender, so it is a safe neutral choice in everyday Cantonese.
Often used with workplace words like 餐廳、茶餐廳、酒樓、酒店, and with action verbs such as 叫、搵、請.
